# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **GLES interop refinement**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.155 release modernizes GLES interop and updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — OpenGL ES interop signatures now use pointer-based parameters, aligning the managed bindings with the native API. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Engine

- **Bundled HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Text shaping uses the current HarfBuzz 14.4.0 release bundled with SkiaSharp. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))
